stories.title: Work stops on Google data center project after Wayne County says it lacks permit
stories.summary: Wayne County has issued a stop-work order for Google's "Project Cannoli" data center in Van Buren Township, citing a lack of proper county construction permits and potential impacts on county drains. The developer, Panattoni, is accused of working within easement areas and obstructing drains, creating flood risks. The project is expected to require significant power, equivalent to a city's electricity needs.
entities: Wayne County Department of Public Services

stories.title: 'Round Every Corner: Ypsi clown community reflects national clowning trend
stories.summary: Ypsilanti's "Ypsi Clown Darlings" host monthly clown socials at Dzanc House, drawing performers from across the region. Co-founders Kieren Berres and Levi Robinson, inspired by political clowning, see it as a form of protest and a way to cope with current societal absurdities, while others view it through a lens of nostalgia or as a trade.

stories.title: School of Education’s new direct admit program expands opportunities for aspiring teachers
stories.summary: The University of Michigan's School of Education now offers a direct admission program for freshmen, allowing students to begin education coursework immediately. This aims to better prepare future teachers and address nationwide shortages by providing earlier engagement with the profession and more practice in supported environments.

stories.title: New net-zero community will become Michigan’s first virtual power plant
stories.summary: Ann Arbor's Veridian at County Farm, a net-zero energy community, is launching Michigan's first residential virtual power plant pilot. DTE Energy will remotely control residents' home batteries to inject stored solar power into the grid during peak demand, potentially reducing utility costs and strengthening reliability for consumers. The pilot aims to test this approach for future scalability.

photo.alt: Powerful living: The net-zero energy community Veridian at County Farm will host Michigan’s first residential virtual power plant with battery manufacturer Sonnen USA.

inputFacts.title: New net-zero community will become Michigan’s first virtual power plant

The project will allow the utility to remotely manage home batteries to store and share solar energy, aiming to improve grid reliability and lower costs for residents.

editorial.reason: This story details a significant local energy initiative in Ann Arbor, involving DTE Energy, which could impact energy costs and reliability for DTE customers, including those in Canton and Plymouth. It represents a novel approach to grid management in Michigan.

stories.title: AAPS officials say new teacher contract is a step forward, but not a final fix
stories.summary: Ann Arbor Public Schools and the Ann Arbor Education Association reached a contract agreement in September, including a 1.5% salary raise for some staff and a 5% increase in the district's healthcare budget. Officials view it as a step toward financial recovery, but not a final fix for teacher concerns.

stories.title: A look back: Gretchen Whitmer 8 years as Michigan’s governor
stories.summary: As Governor Whitmer concludes her eight-year term, her administration's impact includes repairing over 20,000 lane miles and 1,400 bridges, approving nearly $2 billion annually for roads, and expanding childcare subsidies to make 105,000 more children eligible. Free K-12 school meals were also implemented statewide, though some programs face vulnerability as federal pandemic-era funds diminish.
